export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page (slug gearspect-india-private-limited) shows 28 records, all inbound: e.g. "2025-11-26 | GEARSPECT INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED | SMPR METROLOGIE INDUSTRIELLE | CONTROL CONTACT (HARD METAL) 1.00MM PART NO 031-037 | PUNE DIGHI ICD, India | LE HAVRE, FRANCE | 90318000 | 8388730" — origin France/Korea, destination India; no outbound (India-origin) shipment line appears in the visible rows. Source counter: page states "Total Shipments 28 Records detected"; rows actually seen: 5 (all imports).
note: Address on record: UNIT NO. 654 PENTAGON TOWERS P2, MAGARPATTA CITY, HADAPSAR, PUNE, MAHARASHTRA PIN-411013. Declared HS 846140 (gear cutting machines) does not match the observed trade activity: all visible customs lines are HS 90318000 (measuring/checking instruments) imported from France (SMPR Metrologie Industrielle, MAHR France) and Korea (Taechang Trading Corporation) — i.e. the company appears to be an importer/distributor of metrology equipment, not an exporter of gear-cutting machines. No export records with India as origin found; no GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender or contract evidence could be retrieved (web_search backend returned connection refused; volza returned HTTP 403; Google returned HTTP 429), so domestic supply status is unknown, not confirmed. Revenue and export volume: null (not public in accessible sources). No shipment traces of supplies by this company were found in the sources checked — only inbound imports.
